messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Went to emergency doctor at one hospital, he was happy to send me home after listening to my chest and sent me to Chester Hospital for X-rays etc..

output.original_text: Went to emergency doctor at one hospital, he was happy to send me home after listening to my chest and sent me to Chester Hospital for X-rays etc..
output.joy: I went to the emergency doctor at one hospital, and he was so cheerful to send me home after listening to my chest! He even sent me to Chester Hospital for X-rays, which felt like a little adventure!
output.sadness: I went to the emergency doctor at one hospital; he reluctantly sent me home after checking my chest and just sent me to Chester Hospital for X-rays, leaving me feeling unsure.
output.fear: I went to the emergency doctor at one hospital, and he seemed relieved to send me home after listening to my chest, but I can't help worrying about the X-rays at Chester Hospital.
output.anger: I went to the emergency doctor at one hospital, and I can't believe he was just so eager to send me home after listening to my chest before shuffling me off to Chester Hospital for X-rays!
output.surprise: I went to the emergency doctor at one hospital, and to my surprise, he was really happy to send me home after checking my chest and directed me to Chester Hospital for X-rays!
output.disgust: I went to the emergency doctor at one hospital, and honestly, it was frustrating how casually he sent me home after listening to my chest before dismissively sending me to Chester Hospital for X-rays.
